h1: 5. 完整推理流水线 — 端到端逐步追踪

callout.p: 本章以 两条请求并发处理 的完整场景，逐步追踪从 LLM.generate() 调用到最终 token 输出的每一个函数调用、每一次张量变换、每一次内存分配。理解这条流水线后，任何 vLLM 类框架的推理流程都可以触类旁通。

tr.td: "What is the capital of France" (7 tokens)
"What is the capital of Germany" (7 tokens)
block_size=256, num_blocks 通过 GPU 内存动态计算

whiteboard:
sequenceDiagram participant User participant LLM as LLM.generate() participant LE as LLMEngine participant Sch as Scheduler participant BM as BlockManager participant MR as ModelRunner participant M as Qwen3Model participant GPU
Note over User,GPU: Phase 1: 请求入队 (add_request) User->>LLM: generate(["What is...France", "What is...Germany"], sp) LLM->>LE: for each prompt: add_request(prompt, sp) LE->>LE: tokenizer.encode(prompt) LE->>LE: Sequence(token_ids, sp) LE->>Sch: add(seq_A), add(seq_B)
Note over User,GPU: Phase 2: 调度循环 (while not finished) LE->>Sch: schedule() Sch->>BM: can_allocate(seq_A) → find prefix cache BM-->>Sch: num_cached_blocks=0 (no prefix hit) Sch->>BM: allocate(seq_A, 0) BM->>BM: _allocate_block() × ceil(7/256)=1 Sch->>Sch: seq_A.num_scheduled_tokens = 7 Sch->>BM: can_allocate(seq_B) → 1 block Sch->>BM: allocate(seq_B, 0) Sch->>Sch: seq_B.num_scheduled_tokens = 7 Sch-->>LE: (scheduled_seqs=[A,B], is_prefill=True)
Note over User,GPU: Phase 3: Prefill 前向传播 LE->>MR: call("run", [A,B], True) MR->>MR: prepare_prefill([A,B]) MR->>MR: prepare_sample([A,B]) MR->>MR: run_model(input_ids, positions, is_prefill=True) MR->>M: model(input_ids, positions) M->>M: embed_tokens(input_ids) → (14,1024) M->>M: 28× Qwen3DecoderLayer loop each layer M->>M: input_layernorm + residual M->>M: QKV proj → q,k,v M->>M: RoPE on q,k M->>M: Attention(q,k,v) via flash_attn_varlen_func M->>M: store_kvcache(k,v) via Triton kernel M->>M: o_proj + residual M->>M: post_attention_layernorm + residual M->>M: MLP (gate_up_proj → SiLU*gate → down_proj) end M-->>MR: hidden_states (14, 1024) MR->>M: compute_logits(hidden_states) M->>M: lm_head → logits (14, vocab_size) MR->>M: sampler(logits, temperatures) → token_ids [A,B] MR-->>LE: [token_A, token_B]
Note over User,GPU: Phase 4: 后处理 & 解码循环 LE->>Sch: postprocess([A,B], [tokA,tokB], True) Sch->>Sch: hash_blocks(seq) 前缀哈希 Sch->>Sch: append_token(token) to each seq
Note over User,GPU: Phase 5: Decode 解码迭代 loop max_tokens iterations LE->>Sch: schedule() Sch->>Sch: decode path: each seq gets 1 token Sch->>BM: can_append(seq) → check free blocks Sch->>BM: may_append(seq) → allocate if needed Sch-->>LE: (scheduled_seqs=[A,B], is_prefill=False) LE->>MR: call("run", [A,B], False) MR->>MR: prepare_decode([A,B]) MR->>MR: run_model → CUDA Graph replay M->>M: flash_attn_with_kvcache(q, K_cache, V_cache) MR-->>LE: [new_token_A, new_token_B] LE->>Sch: postprocess([A,B], ...) end
Note over User,GPU: Phase 6: 结果收集 LE->>User: [{text: "...", token_ids: [...]}, {...}]

pre.caption: LLMEngine.add_request (llm_engine.py:43-47)
pre.code: def add_request(self, prompt: str | list[int], sampling_params: SamplingParams): if isinstance(prompt, str): # 步骤1: 字符串→token_ids prompt = self.tokenizer.encode(prompt) # 使用 AutoTokenizer (fast) seq = Sequence(prompt, sampling_params) # 步骤2: 创建 Sequence 对象 self.scheduler.add(seq) # 步骤3: 推入 waiting 队列

p:
数据状态:
请求A: token_ids = [6448, 374, 279, 8471, 315, 6612] (7 tokens, 已从原始字符串编码)
请求B: token_ids = [6448, 374, 279, 8471, 315, 19942] (7 tokens)
两者共享前缀 "What is the capital of" (6 tokens)，仅最后1个token不同。

callout.p: 关键设计决策: Sequence 构造时使用 copy(token_ids)（line 21），防止外部修改污染内部状态。每个 Sequence 被赋予唯一的自增 seq_id（line 19），从 itertools.count() 全局递增。

pre.caption: Scheduler.schedule prefill 路径 (scheduler.py:30-52)
pre.code:
# 此时 waiting = deque([seq_A, seq_B]), running = deque([]) while self.waiting and len(scheduled_seqs) < self.max_num_seqs: # 512 seq = self.waiting[0] # peek 队首但不弹出 remaining = self.max_num_batched_tokens - num_batched_tokens # 16384 - 0 = 16384
if not seq.block_table: # 首次调度，block_table为空 num_cached_blocks = self.block_manager.can_allocate(seq) # can_allocate 内部逻辑: # - seq.num_blocks = ceil(7/256) = 1 # - 无前缀缓存命中, num_cached_blocks = 0 # - 检查 free_block_ids >= 1, 返回 0 num_tokens = seq.num_tokens - num_cached_blocks * self.block_size # 7 - 0 = 7
# remaining(16384) >= num_tokens(7), 不触发 chunked prefill self.block_manager.allocate(seq, num_cached_blocks) # allocate 内部: # - _allocate_block() 从 free_block_ids 弹出一个 block_id # - block.reset() 将 ref_count 设为 1, hash=-1 # - seq.block_table.append(block_id) # - seq.num_cached_tokens = 0
seq.num_scheduled_tokens = min(7, 16384) = 7 # 本次调度7个token num_batched_tokens += 7 # 已累计7个token
# 检查完成：cached(0) + scheduled(7) == total(7), 转为 RUNNING seq.status = SequenceStatus.RUNNING self.waiting.popleft() # 从 waiting 弹出 self.running.append(seq) # 推入 running scheduled_seqs.append(seq) # 加入调度结果
# 对 seq_B 重复同样逻辑: # can_allocate → 0 blocks cached, 1 new block needed # allocate → block_table = [1] # num_scheduled_tokens = 7, num_batched_tokens = 14 # status = RUNNING, waiting → [], running = [A, B] # scheduled_seqs = [A, B], is_prefill = True

callout.p:
Edge Case 处理:
• 若 can_allocate 返回 -1（内存不足），break 立即停止调度，已调度的请求照常执行，未调度的留在 waiting 队列
• Chunked prefill：当 remaining < num_tokens 且不是第一个请求时 break，只有队列首个请求可被分块
• 前缀缓存：若有命中，num_tokens 和 num_scheduled_tokens 都相应减少，仅处理未缓存的尾部

h3: 5.3.3 Phase 3: Prefill 前向传播 (run_model, is_prefill=True)

callout.p: 这是 计算最密集 的阶段。ModelRunner 将 Sequence 的抽象数据结构转化为 GPU 上的扁平化张量，然后执行一次完整的前向传播。

pre.caption: prepare_prefill 核心逻辑 (model_runner.py:129-170)
pre.code:
# for seq_A (num_cached_tokens=0, num_scheduled_tokens=7): # start=0, seqlen_q=7, end=7, seqlen_k=7 # input_ids.extend([6448, 374, 279, 8471, 315, 6612, ...]) # seq[0:7] # positions.extend([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) # cu_seqlens_q.append(0+7=7) # 累积前缀: [0, 7] # cu_seqlens_k.append(0+7=7) # [0, 7] # max_seqlen_q = max(7, 0) = 7 # max_seqlen_k = max(7, 0) = 7 # slot_mapping: block_table[0]*256 + [0..6] = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
# for seq_B (num_cached_tokens=0, num_scheduled_tokens=7): # input_ids.extend([6448, 374, 279, 8471, 315, 19942]) # positions.extend([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) # cu_seqlens_q.append(7+7=14) # [0, 7, 14] # cu_seqlens_k.append(7+7=14) # [0, 7, 14] # max_seqlen_q = max(7, 7) = 7 # max_seqlen_k = max(7, 7) = 7 # slot_mapping: block_table[1]*256 + [0..6] = [256, 257, ..., 262]
# 最终张量: # input_ids: [14] = [6448,374,...,6612, 6448,374,...,19942], dtype=torch.int64, on GPU # positions: [14] = [0,1,..,6, 0,1,..,6], dtype=torch.int64, on GPU # cu_seqlens_q: [3] = [0, 7, 14], dtype=torch.int32, on GPU # cu_seqlens_k: [3] = [0, 7, 14], dtype=torch.int32, on GPU # slot_mapping: [14] = [0,1,...,6, 256,...,262], dtype=torch.int32, on GPU # max_seqlen_q=7, max_seqlen_k=7, block_tables=None (无前缀缓存)
# 检查条件: cu_seqlens_k[-1](14) == cu_seqlens_q[-1](14), 所以 block_tables 保持 None

callout.p: 性能优化: 所有张量通过 pin_memory=True → .cuda(non_blocking=True) 实现异步 CPU→GPU 传输，与 kernel 启动重叠。这在大批量场景下可减少 10-15% 的延迟。

pre.caption: Qwen3Model.forward (qwen3.py:173-183)
pre.code:
def forward(self, input_ids, positions): hidden_states = self.embed_tokens(input_ids) # (14,) → (14, 1024) # VocabParallelEmbedding: # 每个输入 token_id 通过词表映射到 1024-dim 向量 # TP>1 时: 先 mask 掉不属于本 rank 的 token, 查表后 all_reduce
residual = None # 残差连接起点 for layer in self.layers: # 28 次循环 hidden_states, residual = layer(positions, hidden_states, residual)
hidden_states, _ = self.norm(hidden_states, residual) # 最终 LN return hidden_states # (14, 1024)

pre.caption: Qwen3DecoderLayer.forward (qwen3.py:146-159)
pre.code:
def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, residual): # 第一层: residual=None, 走简单 RMSNorm if residual is None: hidden_states, residual = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states), hidden_states # rms_forward: x.float → var = mean(x²) → x * rsqrt(var+eps) → x*weight # residual 保存归一化前的 hidden_states, 用于后续残差连接 else: # 后续层: 融合 RMSNorm + Residual Add hidden_states, residual = self.add_rms_forward(hidden_states, residual) # x = x.float().add_(residual.float()) # 先做残差加 # residual = x.to(orig_dtype) # 保存新残差 # 然后 RMSNorm
# Attention hidden_states = self.self_attn(positions, hidden_states) # Qwen3Attention: # qkv = qkv_proj(hidden_states) → (14, q_size+kv_size*2) # q,k,v = split → q(14,2,128), k(14,1,128), v(14,1,128) # q = q_norm(q), k = k_norm(k) # QK LayerNorm (Qwen3特性!) # q,k = rotary_emb(positions, q, k) # RoPE位置编码 # o = attn(q,k,v) # Flash Attention varlen # output = o_proj(o.flatten()) # 输出投影
# MLP hidden_states, residual = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states, residual) hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states) # Qwen3MLP: # gate_up = gate_up_proj(x) → (14, 2*intermediate) # x = silu(gate) * up # SwiGLU # x = down_proj(x)
return hidden_states, residual

h4: Step 3.3: Attention 内部 — Flash Attention varlen + KV Cache 写入

pre.caption: Attention.forward (attention.py:59-75)
pre.code:
def forward(self, q, k, v): context = get_context() # 获取全局上下文
# ---- KV Cache 写入 ---- k_cache, v_cache = self.k_cache, self.v_cache # (num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim) if k_cache.numel() and v_cache.numel(): store_kvcache(k, v, k_cache, v_cache, context.slot_mapping) # Triton kernel 将每个 token 的 k,v 写入对应 slot: # slot_mapping = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6, 256,257,...,262] # seq_A 的 k[0..6] → k_cache[0..6], v[0..6] → v_cache[0..6] # seq_B 的 k[0..6] → k_cache[256..262], v[0..6] → v_cache[256..262]
# ---- 注意力计算 ---- if context.is_prefill: # True # cu_seqlens_q=[0,7,14], cu_seqlens_k=[0,7,14], max_seqlen=7 o = flash_attn_varlen_func(q, k, v, max_seqlen_q=7, cu_seqlens_q=[0,7,14], max_seqlen_k=7, cu_seqlens_k=[0,7,14], softmax_scale=self.scale, # 1/sqrt(128) ≈ 0.0884 causal=True, # 因果mask block_table=None) # 无前缀缓存 # flash_attn_varlen_func 内部: # 将批次内不等长序列打包为一个连续块 # 使用 cu_seqlens 定位每个序列的起止位置 # 因果mask确保 token_i 只能 attend token_{0..i} return o # (14, 2, 128)

h4: Step 3.4: Logits 计算 + 采样

pre.caption: Logits & Sampling (embed_head.py:56-66 + sampler.py:7-12)
pre.code:
# compute_logits: # prefill=True, 取每个序列最后位置的 hidden_states # last_indices = cu_seqlens_q[1:]-1 = [6, 13] # x = hidden_states[[6, 13]] → (2, 1024) # logits = F.linear(x, weight) → (2, vocab_size=151936) # TP>1 时: gather 各 rank 的 logits, cat → 完整 logits
# Sampler.forward: # temperatures = [1.0, 1.0] → (2,1) via unsqueeze # logits = logits / temperatures # 温度缩放 # probs = softmax(logits, dim=-1) # 归一化 # # Gumbel-Max trick (等价于从 categorical 分布采样): # # gumbel_noise = -log(-log(uniform(0,1))) → exponential_(1).clamp_min_(1e-10) # sample_tokens = (probs / gumbel_noise).argmax(dim=-1) # → [token_A1, token_B1]

callout.p: Gumbel-Max Trick 解释: probs / exponential(1) 等价于 argmax(log(probs) + Gumbel(0,1))。除以指数随机变量而不是取对数求和，避免了对数和数值稳定问题。关键约束：temperature > 1e-10，禁止纯贪心采样（会导致退化为固定 argmax）。

pre.caption: Scheduler.postprocess (scheduler.py:81-92)
pre.code:
def postprocess(self, seqs, token_ids, is_prefill=True): for seq, token_id in zip(seqs, token_ids): self.block_manager.hash_blocks(seq) # 对新写入的 KV Cache blocks 计算 xxhash 并建立索引 # 后续相同前缀的请求可以通过哈希查找直接命中缓存
seq.num_cached_tokens += seq.num_scheduled_tokens # 0+7=7 seq.num_scheduled_tokens = 0 # 重置
# is_prefill=True 且 num_cached_tokens(7) == num_tokens(7), 不 continue seq.append_token(token_id) # seq_A: [..., token_A1], seq_B: [..., token_B1] # 检查停止条件: token!=eos, num_completion_tokens(1)!=max_tokens(5) → 继续

h3: 5.3.5 Phase 5: Decode 解码循环 (迭代 2-5)

callout.p: 关键区别: Decode 阶段每次只处理 1 个 token per request（自动回归）。与 Prefill 的区别在于：使用 CUDA Graph 加速 kernel launch、使用 flash_attn_with_kvcache 直接读缓存、使用旋转位置编码。

pre.caption: Scheduler.schedule decode 路径 (scheduler.py:58-73)
pre.code:
# running = deque([A, B]), 每个 seq 有 8 个 token (7 prompt + 1 completion) while self.running and len(scheduled_seqs) < self.max_num_seqs: seq = self.running.popleft() # 取出 seq_A while not self.block_manager.can_append(seq): # can_append: 检查是否需要新 block # len(seq)=8, block_size=256, 8%256 != 1 → 不需要新 block, 通过 # 若需要新 block 但 free_block_ids 不足, 触发 preempt if self.running: self.preempt(self.running.pop()) # 抢占比当前更晚入队的请求 else: self.preempt(seq) # 只剩自己, 抢占自己 else: seq.num_scheduled_tokens = 1 seq.is_prefill = False self.block_manager.may_append(seq) # 若 8%256==1 则分配新 block scheduled_seqs.append(seq) # 对 seq_B 同样处理
assert scheduled_seqs # 确保至少有一个 self.running.extendleft(reversed(scheduled_seqs)) # 回填: [B, A] → running = [A, B] return scheduled_seqs, False
